units: <cite ref="Nazir 59a:7">Naz. 59ᵃ</cite> <he>מהו לָחוֹךְ</he> how about (removing the hair by) rubbing (Tosaf.: <he>לחוך ולהִתְחַכֵּךְ</he> about rubbing or being rubbed)?

<cite ref="Mishnah Nedarim 1:1">Ned. I, 1</cite> <he>היה חוֹכֵךְ בזה להחמיר</he> had some hesitation about deciding in favor of greater stringency (for the expression <he>מנודה</he>; oth. opin. in R. N. to Bab.
ib. 7ᵃ: denom. of חֵךְ, had a taste for &c.).

senses.gloss: to rub one’s self against a rough object; to be rubbed.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 4:6">B. Kam. IV, 6</cite> <he>שור שהיה מִתְחַכֵּךְ וכ׳</he> an ox that scratched himself against a wall; <cite ref="Tosefta Bava Kamma 4:6">Tosef. ib. IV, 6</cite>.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 3a:14">B. Kam. 3ᵃ</cite> <he>נִתְחַכְּכָה וכ׳</he> she (the animal) scratched herself against a wall for her gratification (without intention to do injury) &c.—

Gen. R. s. 67 (play on הכי, Gen. XXVII, 36) התחיל מְחַכֵּךְ בגרונו וכ׳ he began to hawk with his throat (to express contempt), like one that hawks and spits; Tanḥ. Ki Thetsé 10; Pesik. Zakh., p. 27ᵇ, v. זְמוֹרָה; [Ar. ed. Koh. s. v. זמר: חִיכְחֵךְ, Pilp.]—Cmp. כָּחַח.
